subject: CS477
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is weaker; while good videos were found for most topics, they often had to be selected from a smaller pool of candidates, sometimes requiring the use of more general computer architecture lectures or applying the view count exception. One Arabic topic, 'Bitwise Logic and Shifts', had no eligible candidates.

coverage.note: Most candidates were for x86 architecture and thus irrelevant.
No ARM-specific videos found. Selected a general conceptual video under the view count exception rule as no other candidate passed the relevance gate.
Selected a high-view comparative architecture lecture as dedicated videos had very low view counts.
All candidates failed hard gates, being either for the wrong architecture (x86/8085), wrong topic (high-level languages), or in the wrong language.

videos.title: ARM7 Addressing Modes Explained: Pre-Index and Post-Index | ARM7 | ARM Processor
videos.topic_ar: أنماط العنونة في لغة التجميع ARM
videos.filter_reason: Highly relevant, high view count, and provides a clear, structured explanation of the fundamental addressing modes in ARM7.

videos.title: Getting Started with ARM Memory Management Using "The Stack"  |  R13/SP Control in ARM Assembly
videos.filter_reason: Perfectly titled for the topic, specific to ARM, has a high view count, and directly addresses stack pointer management for function calls.

videos.title: ARM Instruction Set - Branching Instructions - B, BL,BX,BLX
videos.filter_reason: Highest view count among many strong candidates, providing a focused and comprehensive explanation of ARM's key branching instructions.

videos.title: Lecture 23. Load and Store Instructions
videos.filter_reason: The best candidate with a very high view count, offering a concise and focused explanation of ARM's fundamental load/store instructions.

videos.title: ARM Instruction Set - Shift & Rotate Instructions- LSL, LSR, ASL, ASR,ROR, RRX
videos.filter_reason: Excellent peer validation with the highest view count, this video provides a comprehensive guide to ARM's unique and important shift and rotate operations.

videos.title: الدرس ٤٤ : ARM Instruction Set Architecture - P1
videos.topic_ar: أنماط العنونة في لغة التجميع ARM
videos.filter_reason: The only eligible Arabic video found that is a dedicated, in-depth lecture on ARM ISA, which includes addressing modes.

videos.title: Stack Part 1 - Function call and Return problem.
videos.filter_reason: The most relevant Arabic video available, explaining the core concept of using the stack for function calls, selected under the view count exception rule.

videos.title: Computer Organization and Design-10: Immediate and Branch Instructions and Synchronization
videos.filter_reason: A highly relevant video that explicitly covers conditional and unconditional branch instructions for ARM processors in Arabic.

videos.title: Computer Architecture - تنظيم وبناء الحاسب - Lecture 3 - Part 2\3
videos.filter_reason: A high-view comparative lecture that explains the ARM ISA in contrast to x86, effectively teaching the load/store concept which is a core differentiator.
